note: 「공백마다 점자 빈칸」 우회 프리셋 꼴의 인사말 (이름 · 글은 지어낸 것). 시험이 빈칸을 모두 점자 빈칸(U+2800)으로 바꿔 메시지로 써요 — 색 태그 속 빈칸까지
name: Office of Joint Affairs
text: The lamination on the Notice of Morning Etiquette is still warm from the copier, heating the tips of your fingers.
「いや〜、最初は俺もびっくりしたんすけどね！ ほら、新年度じゃないっすか？ 室長が『挨拶運動を徹底する』って急に言い出して！」
Corvin taps the fake seal at the bottom of the page with a gloved knuckle, his cowlick bobbing as he nods. A bell chimes as the elevator doors open behind him.
「そうそう。新人さんだし、お堅い子こそ柔軟なユーモアを取り入れてもらわないと困るって、室長が真剣な顔で言ってたよ〜」
Mira stares down at the bold print. *Article 4, Section 2: all secretaries must append the suffix 'Nyan' to the standard greeting.* Below the text sits a diagram of a stick figure.
Teodor steps out of the office, shuts the door with a quiet click and adjusts his glasses. Somewhere down the hall a keyboard clatters.
「冗談に見えるか。明日の朝から実施だ。以上」
*He means it,* Mira thinks. Nell drops a stack of paper on the desk with a thud.
「じゃ、練習しよっか〜。ほら、手はこう！」
